content:
With the Liquid Glass redesign rolling out to most iOS WhatsApp users, the messaging platform is now testing another visual tweak, this time focused on the styling of conversation bubbles. Here's what we know so far.

A fresh, rounder look for chat bubbles

Several months ago, WhatsApp finally began rolling out its Liquid Glass redesign more broadly after months of testing and refinement, via TestFlight to select groups of users.

Around the same time, WABetaInfo spotted signs in the app's code pointing to a redesign of WhatsApp's conversation bubbles. According to a new report from the site, the new bubble design has now started going out to some users via the latest TestFlight build.

Here's a quote from WABetaInfo's report:

Beyond the change in shape of message bubbles, the new design also adjusts how media and links appear in chats. WhatsApp has removed the green borders around them, giving photos, videos, animated GIFs and link previews a cleaner, more unified look.

According to WABetaInfo, the new design is currently available to only a small number of WhatsApp TestFlight users, and a timeline for a wider rollout to all iOS users has yet to be confirmed.
